name: Vibe-Coded To-Do List
description: A production-grade React/TypeScript to-do application with persistence, filtering, and accessibility.

details: Initialize npm project with defaults.
Install React and React-DOM as production dependencies.
Install TypeScript, Vite, and @vitejs/plugin-react as dev dependencies.
Install Vitest, jsdom, and @testing-library/react as dev dependencies for testing.
Install @types/react and @types/react-dom for TypeScript support.
Create tsconfig.json with modern React and TypeScript settings.
Create tsconfig.node.json for Vite configuration file.
Create vite.config.ts in the root directory.
Configure Vite to use the React plugin and set up Vitest with 'jsdom' environment.
Ensure the build script in package.json is correctly configured for production.
Create index.html in the project root with a root div and script tag pointing to src/main.tsx.
Create src/main.tsx to bootstrap the React application into the root element.
Create src/App.tsx as the main application container with a basic functional component.
Create src/App.css for global application styling.
Verify the application compiles and renders a basic title in the browser.
tests: Should render 'To-Do List' title in the document
Should mount the React application without crashing
Should have a root element with id 'root' in index.html

details: Create tests/setup.ts to configure @testing-library/jest-dom matchers.
Update vite.config.ts to include the setup file in the test configuration.
Create a dummy test file tests/smoke.test.ts to verify the test runner works.
Configure the 'test' script in package.json to run 'vitest run'.
Ensure 'src/' and 'tests/' directories are correctly mapped in the project structure.

tests: Vitest should successfully run and pass a basic smoke test
The application should render a placeholder title on the screen

details: Define the 'Todo' interface in src/types.ts with id, text, and completed fields.
Implement useTodos custom hook in src/hooks/useTodos.ts to manage todo list state.
Add 'addTodo' functionality to the hook to append new items with unique IDs.
Add 'toggleTodo' functionality to the hook to flip the completion status.
Add 'deleteTodo' functionality to the hook to remove items by ID.
tests: Should add a new todo to the state correctly
Should toggle a todo from incomplete to completed
Should remove a todo from the list by its ID
Should initialize with an empty array of todos

details: Create src/components/AddTodo.tsx as a controlled component with an input field.
Implement a form submission handler to prevent default browser behavior.
Add validation to prevent adding empty or whitespace-only todos.
Clear the input field after a successful todo addition.
Pass the 'addTodo' function as a prop from the parent component.
tests: Should allow typing into the todo input field
Should call the addition callback when the form is submitted
Should clear the input field after clicking the add button
Should disable or ignore submission if the input is empty

details: Create src/components/TodoItem.tsx to render individual todo details.
Include a checkbox in TodoItem for toggling completion and a delete button.
Create src/components/TodoList.tsx to map over the array of todos.
Pass necessary callbacks (toggle, delete) from App.tsx down through TodoList.
Ensure each item in the list has a stable and unique 'key' prop.
tests: Should render a list containing all current todos
Should display the correct text for each todo item
Should show a checkbox as checked if the todo is completed
Should call the delete callback when the delete button is clicked
Adding a todo should update the displayed list immediately
Toggling a checkbox should strike through the text (if CSS applied)
Deleting a todo should remove it from the document

details: Modify useTodos hook to load the initial state from localStorage on mount.
Implement a useEffect hook to sync the todo state to localStorage on every change.
Add error handling for localStorage access (e.g., full storage or blocked access).
Ensure the state is serialized to JSON before storing.
Test that todos persist even after a simulated page refresh.
tests: Should save the todo list to localStorage whenever it changes
Should retrieve and display todos from localStorage on application start
Should handle empty localStorage by defaulting to an empty list

details: Add filter state (All, Active, Completed) to src/App.tsx.
Implement logic to filter the displayed todos based on the selected filter.
Create src/components/Filters.tsx to render navigation/filter buttons.
Add a count of remaining active todos to be displayed near the filters.
Highlight the currently active filter button for visual feedback.
tests: Should show only uncompleted todos when 'Active' filter is selected
Should show only completed todos when 'Completed' filter is selected
Should show all todos when 'All' filter is selected
Should update the 'items left' count correctly when todos are added/deleted

details: Implement 'Clear Completed' button to remove all finished todos at once.
Update TodoItem to support double-click to enter edit mode.
Implement an input field in TodoItem for editing existing todo text.
Save changes on 'Enter' key press or when the input loses focus (blur).
Cancel editing and revert changes if the 'Escape' key is pressed.
tests: Should remove all completed todos when 'Clear Completed' is clicked
Should switch to edit mode when a todo item is double-clicked
Should update the todo text after editing and pressing Enter
Should revert to original text if Escape is pressed during editing
Filtering should work correctly across different states
Todos should persist across browser sessions
Inline editing should properly update the state and localStorage

details: Implement a clean, modern UI using Vanilla CSS in src/App.css.
Apply responsive styles using media queries for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Add CSS transitions for smooth hover states and state changes.
Use CSS variables for theme colors (background, primary, text).
Implement a visually distinct 'completed' state (e.g., grayed out, line-through).
tests: Should have a layout that adjusts for small screen widths
Should display completed todos with a line-through decoration
Should have accessible color contrast for all text elements

details: Add semantic HTML tags (header, main, footer, section) for better screen reader support.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs) have descriptive aria-labels.
Implement full keyboard navigation support (tab index, focus management).
Add 'Enter' key support for adding and editing todos without a mouse.
Verify the application is usable with standard accessibility tools.
tests: Should allow adding a todo using only the keyboard
Should have focus indicators for all interactive elements
Should provide aria-labels for the delete and filter buttons

details: Use React.memo to prevent unnecessary re-renders of the TodoItem component.
Implement useCallback for toggle and delete handlers passed to TodoList.
Ensure expensive filtering operations are memoized using useMemo if necessary.
Analyze the component tree to minimize deep prop drilling where possible.
Run a production build and verify the bundle size is optimized.
tests: Should not re-render unaffected todo items when a new one is added
Should maintain smooth performance with a large number of todos (e.g., 100+)
Should have a clean production build without console errors
The application should be fully accessible via keyboard
The UI should remain consistent and usable across different device sizes
Performance should be optimal even with frequent state updates
